Application Data.NAME: Greenfield Market
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Greenfield Market operates as a full-service supermarket and grocery store, offering a wide range of products including fresh produce, packaged foods, beverages, household items, and personal care products. The store prioritizes customer satisfaction by providing a clean and organized shopping environment, ensuring product quality, and maintaining competitive pricing. Additionally, we engage in local sourcing where possible to support community farmers and suppliers, and offer delivery services to enhance convenience for our customers.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On April 15, 2023, a water leak from a malfunctioning refrigeration unit caused damage to the flooring and inventory in the produce section. The estimated loss amount was $3,000. The claim was reported and is currently under review with the insurance company. Additionally, on July 22, 2023, a slip and fall incident occurred in the store due to a spilled beverage, resulting in a payout of $500 for medical expenses. Both incidents have been documented and actions have been taken to prevent future occurrences.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel during business hours, CCTV monitoring system, perimeter fencing, and regular safety inspections.
